text_translated: Printed p. 100: the same series of electrolyses made at -1.8 V was repeated at -2.2 V; 'the electrolyte concentration does not significantly affect the reduction rate at this potential, taking into account the experimental error'. Printed p. 101: although the rate is unaffected, nitrite profiles differ (Diag 7.8): with 0.1 M NaCl nitrite peaked at 5.5 mM, with 3 M NaCl it did not exceed 0.5 mM.
